explanation: Pudlák (arXiv:1601.01487, §4): 'Conjecture (equivalent to TFNP) There is no complete problem in TFNP, i.e., there exist no TFNP problem to which all TFNP problems can be reduced' (Megiddo–Papadimitriou). TFNPProblem is a polytime relation with polynomially bounded, always existing solutions; Reduces is the standard many-one search reduction (f on instances, g mapping solutions back). Pudlák shows completeness under polynomial (oracle) reductions and under many-one reductions give equivalent conjectures. Faithful.
